basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old resident of Florida, currently trying to land a job at a local water plant. My interests vary from watching hilarious commercials to exploring niche hobbies like suppressors. I recently got engaged, and we're in the early stages of wedding planning, which is both exciting and overwhelming. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or on weekends when I have some downtime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school diploma and some community college experience, though most of my knowledge comes from hands-on work. Over the years, I've worked in various short-term jobs, which has given me a broad but informal understanding of different fields. I'm not particularly well-versed in legal matters, hence my concern about employment history disclosures.
